rebuttals.justification: Critic's R3 PARTIAL correctly identifies that the calibration probe (hand-authored seeded smells) cannot surface a style-directive confound that manifests only in model-generated outputs under a minimalism preamble. DEFER question 4 fails: confound is asymmetric (python_coder_agent's minimalism directive deflates only its comment scores). Switching DEFER→CONCEDE. Fix: pre-main-run, generate ≥10 python_coder_agent outputs on 2-3 tasks, score with both current (unanchored) judge prompt and a complexity-anchored variant. If mean comment_quality difference > 0.5 points, amend judge prompt and log as pre-reg drift event per SPEC §7. Settles confound empirically before main-run data collection.
